Definition: properly, a pebble, i.e. a lot (small stones being used for that purpose); figuratively, a portion or destiny (as if determined by lot)
BiblicalUsage: gôwrâl is the word for a lot, a portion, a destiny. In Leviticus 16:8, the text says "And Aaron shall cast lots upon the two goats." In Numbers 26:55, the text says "Notwithstanding the land shall be divided by lot."
TheologicalSignificance: gôwrâl convinces me that faith is not a feeling but a holding-on — trusting what God has said when nothing else makes sense. That is why I keep this word in mind when I read those passages — it carries more than its size suggests.
